GREEN.label: Monitoring
GREEN.description: No canary milestones triggered. Quantum computing progressing but no cryptographically relevant demonstrations.

YELLOW.label: Milestones Triggered
YELLOW.description: Significant milestones confirm quantum progress toward cryptographic relevance. Does not indicate imminent threat.

ORANGE.label: Watch Closely
ORANGE.description: Timeline compressing. Conditions for a cryptographic break are forming.

RED.label: Canary Down
RED.description: Cryptographically relevant quantum factoring demonstrated. Remaining gap to Q-Day is an engineering problem.

triggered.event: NIST finalizes first 3 post-quantum encryption standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA)

CISA releases Product Categories for PQC-Capable Technologies — federal procurement benchmark
QuEra demonstrates 96 logical qubits on neutral-atom processor (Nature)
Google Quantum AI + EF + Stanford — 10x Shor optimization for secp256k1 ECDLP (~1,200-1,450 LQ, <500K physical, ~9 min runtime); ZK-disclosed
Oratomic / Caltech / UC Berkeley — Shor's algorithm on secp256k1 with only ~10K reconfigurable neutral-atom qubits
First non-trivial quantum ECDLP attack — 15-bit elliptic-curve key recovered (Project Eleven Q-Day Prize)
Bitcoin BIP-361 proposed — 3-phase post-quantum migration with legacy signature sunset
Schrottenloher independently rediscovers Google's secret ECDLP optimization (arXiv); Gidney discloses year-long censorship pressure; ecdsa.fail crowdsourced challenge -8.4% past Google
